_approach: Wikipedia credits 'the rhythmic intensity of breakcore/jungle' as a direct influence. A classic amen-break skeleton (kick on 1, snare drags on the 'a' of 1 and beat 3, ghost snare on the '&' of 3) re-pitched to dariacore tempo rather than jungle's 160–180, with the ride standing in for the break's characteristic ride-cymbal wash — the amen chop played nearly straight, before any further re-slicing a producer would do on the actual audio.
